name: My puppy: Golden Retriever
summary: Your gentle Golden Retriever is ready to fill your mixed reality world with love! Kind-hearted and affectionate, it adores being near you. Feed it crunchy biscuits and juicy chicken legs, then toss a ball or toy bone to share playful joy. When it leans closer, reach out to pat its silky head or rub its belly—it’ll gaze at you with pure affection. This loyal companion brings calm, comfort, and golden warmth to your space. Experience the true meaning of friendship with your Golden Retriever!
